versions.subject: feat: add rules related to rogue rdp
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\mstsc.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'mstsc.exe'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains: '.rdp'
filter_optional_wsl:
    ParentImage: 'C:\Windows\System32\lxss\wslhost.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\WSL\wslg.rdp'
condition: all of selection_* and not 1 of selection_optional_*

versions.subject: fix: filter

selection_cli|endswith:
    CommandLine|contains:

        - '.rdp"'
